'''Field armor''' was the basic [[Armor/Legends|armor]] combination of shoulder pads, breastplate and helmet worn by [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]]. [[Imperial Army Special Missions trooper/Legends|Imperial Army Special Missions troopers]] wore similar armor with additional plates on each upper arm.<ref name="SpecForce">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
